name: VC Sports Group
status: Active. On 27 Nov 2026 its client Teruaki Sato's 6-year contract with the Chicago Cubs was announced, reported at $120 million. This page is a short first version: the public record I could open is thin.
summary: An American baseball agency best known for Dodgers star Mookie Betts. It has become a second route to MLB for Japanese players, next to the bigger Wasserman (THE·TEAM): it handled pitcher Tomoyuki Sugano's moves and, in 2026, the largest contract ever reported for a Japanese position player.
quick_facts: A US agency that represents baseball players in contract talks with MLB clubs
Teruaki Sato (confirmed), Tomoyuki Sugano (confirmed). Shota Morishita: reported by a blog citing Daily Sports, not confirmed
Sean Novak: named by the tabloid Nikkan Gendai and by a blog citing Daily Sports. Not confirmed by a source I could open
Not confirmed. Not researched in this first version

sections.title: In short
sections.intro: Most top Japanese pitchers in MLB use one agency, Wasserman. Sato chose a different one about two years before he left Japan. That agency talked to his Japanese club for him, which is still unusual in Japan, and finished his MLB deal in 23 days.

cells: Handles Mookie Betts's 12-year, $365 million extension with the Dodgers, according to Number Web.
Pitcher Jacob deGrom moves to the agency (theScore). Number Web credits it with his 5-year, $185 million Texas Rangers deal in 2022.
Teruaki Sato signs with the agency when he formally tells Hanshin he wants MLB (Sports Hochi).
Tomoyuki Sugano joins the Baltimore Orioles with the agency's help; a year later, the Colorado Rockies (Number Web).
Sato says his agent and Hanshin spent a long time on posting and salary before he signed, the last player in Japan to do so.
Sato agrees with the Cubs: 6 years, reported $120 million. MLB Trade Rumors lists VC Sports Group as his representative.

sections.title: Method: what it did for Sato

rows: It negotiated with the Japanese club, not only with MLB clubs. Sato said his agent and Hanshin talked through posting and salary together.
https://news.yahoo.co.jp/articles/6f3424a228fe40ccc674bc5bdff5766a875c13ba
It used the yearly contract as the moment to press. Sato stayed unsigned until 30 Jan 2026, then signed for one year only, with posting talks continuing.
https://www.daily.co.jp/tigers/2026/01/31/0019970204.shtml
It moved fast once the window opened: posted 1 Nov, agreed 24 Nov, ahead of the 1 Dec labour deadline.
https://www.mlb.com/news/teruaki-sato-mlb-posting-system
It connected him with a star client: he trained with Mookie Betts in Dec 2025 (headline only).
https://www.daily.co.jp/tigers/2025/12/19/0019828890.shtml
The result beat the market forecast: MLB Trade Rumors had predicted 5 years and $80 million.
https://www.mlbtraderumors.com/2026/11/cubs-to-sign-teruaki-sato.html

Not reported for Sato. In MLB the player normally pays the agent a percentage of his contract; the percentage here is not public. See the Wasserman page on this site for how baseball agency fees usually work.

sections.title: Controversies and criticism
sections.intro: None found about the agency itself (searched 27 Nov 2026; a light check).

rows: Tabloid framing: Nikkan Gendai wrote of Sato 'forcing through' a move, and other tabloids called his training with Betts a Dodgers attempt to fence him in. Neither happened: Hanshin approved the posting and he signed with the Cubs.
https://www.nikkan-gendai.com/articles/view/sports/391747
The other side of a hard negotiation: Sankei Sports described player and club as running in parallel lines in January 2026. The club's answer was that a player's wish alone is never enough.
https://www.daily.co.jp/tigers/2026/10/19/0020945650.shtml
A hitter does not have to use the agency the pitchers use. A record contract for a star hitter (Betts) was the selling point here.
Hiring the agent two years early mattered more than the 23 days of bidding. The hard part was getting the Japanese club to say yes.
If Morishita really has signed too, Hanshin now face the same agency for their next star. Worth watching.
Read on 27 Nov 2026. Sato's contract details are still reports, and Betts signed in 2026 with other firms for his personal brand and endorsements, which is separate from contract representation.
